title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Stake Decreased by Colorado Capital Management Inc.
text:
Posted by Brent Sawyer on Jan 30th, 2019 // No Comments
Colorado Capital Management Inc. lowered its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 7.2% in the 3rd quarter, according to its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The fund owned 9,364 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 723 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for about 1.5% of Colorado Capital Management Inc.’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 23rd biggest holding. Colorado Capital Management Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $2,113,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
Several other hedge funds have also bought and sold shares of AAPL. Delphi Private Advisors LLC purchased a new position in shares of Apple in the second quarter worth $120,000. Selective Wealth Management purchased a new position in shares of Apple in the third quarter worth $194,000. Lawson Kroeker Investment Management Inc. NE purchased a new position in shares of Apple in the third quarter worth $201,000. Leith Wheeler Investment Counsel Ltd. purchased a new position in shares of Apple in the third quarter worth $201,000. Finally, Boston Standard Wealth Management LLC purchased a new position in shares of Apple in the third quarter worth $204,000. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 57.02% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts:
In other news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total value of $647,520.00. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares in the company, valued at $1,698,600. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available through this hyperlink . 0.05% of the stock is owned by insiders. Several brokerages recently commented on AAPL. Royal Bank of Canada set a $185.00 price objective on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Monday. BidaskClub lowered Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a report on Tuesday, November 13th. Maxim Group cut their price objective on Apple from $212.00 to $160.00 and set a “hold” rating for the company in a report on Thursday, January 3rd. They noted that the move was a valuation call. ValuEngine lowered Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a report on Wednesday, November 21st. Finally, Sanford C. Bernstein set a $160.00 price objective on Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a report on Thursday, January 3rd. Three equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have issued a hold rating and twenty-two have given a buy rating to the company’s stock. The company currently has an average rating of “Hold” and a consensus price target of $195.33.
NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $154.68 on Wednesday. Apple Inc. has a 52-week low of $142.00 and a 52-week high of $233.47. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a current ratio of 1.12 and a quick ratio of 1.09. The stock has a market cap of $775.41 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 12.99, a P/E/G ratio of 1.52 and a beta of 1.23.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 EPS for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a return on equity of 48.68% and a net margin of 22.41%. The business had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $61.55 billion. During the same period in the previous year, the business earned $2.07 earnings per share. The business’s revenue was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. Equities research analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 11.88 EPS for the current year.
The firm also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 14th. Stockholders of record on Monday, February 11th will be given a $0.73 dividend. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a dividend yield of 1.89%. Apple’s payout ratio is 24.52%. About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
